from pathlib import Path

path = Path("src/aspenops_nexus/models.py")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def replace_once(old: str, new: str) -> None:
    global text
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected one patch target, found {count}: {old[:120]!r}")
    text = text.replace(old, new, 1)


replace_once(
    "from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field\n",
    "from copy import deepcopy\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, fields, is_dataclass\n",
)
helper = '''def _snapshot_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, str | int | float | bool):
        return value
    if type(value) is dict:
        return {key: _snapshot_value(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if type(value) is list:
        return [_snapshot_value(item) for item in value]
    if type(value) is tuple:
        return tuple(_snapshot_value(item) for item in value)
    if is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
        return {
            item.name: _snapshot_value(getattr(value, item.name))
            for item in fields(value)
        }
    return deepcopy(value)
'''
marker = "\n\n@dataclass(slots=True)\nclass EvaluationResult:"
if text.count(marker) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("EvaluationResult insertion marker changed")
text = text.replace(marker, "\n\n" + helper + marker, 1)
replace_once(
    '''    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)
''',
    '''    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            item.name: _snapshot_value(getattr(self, item.name))
            for item in fields(self)
        }
''',
)
if "asdict(" in text:
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected dataclasses.asdict usage remains in models.py")
path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
